layout.arrangement: Figure-only slide. Thin maroon rectangular frame encloses the whole 960x540 canvas. Yellow circular slide-number badge '45' at top-right inside the frame. Center occupied by a single square scatter plot (white background, black axes, dotted gray gridlines) with four colored dot clusters and three filled region blobs. No title, no bullets, no footer.
